comment: Terraria's debuffs, the layer that makes one arrow different from another beyond its numbers. A Flaming Arrow should set things on fire; before this it just exploded, which is a Hellfire Arrow's job. Every effect here is one the engine can actually deliver against a mob: damage over time, a slow, or a multiplier on damage taken. Nothing reduces enemy defense, because mobs in this game do not have any. Durations are short -- a few seconds -- because a round is under a minute and a debuff that outlives the fight is just extra damage on the tooltip.

debuffs.name: Frostburn
debuffs.description: Burns cold, and harder than fire.

debuffs.name: Poisoned

debuffs.description: Everything that hits it afterwards hits harder.
